devices.label:
Windows hosts - Vector agent [AU-12]
Role: ship Security, System, PowerShell/Operational
event logs to the aggregator

data.notes: Purple: event source. vector/agent-windows.yaml, installed by scripts/install-windows-agent.ps1.

devices.label:
Linux hosts - Vector agent [AU-12]
Role: ship journald and auditd (audit.log) events
to the aggregator

AWS logs - OPTIONAL [AU-12]
Role: CloudTrail, GuardDuty, VPC Flow, S3 access logs
in S3; one SQS queue per type announces objects

Vector role hosts - always on [AU-3]
Role: aggregator - native :6000 and HEC :8088,
VRL normalise, disk buffer, INSERT to ClickHouse

data.notes: Teal: ingestion. vector/hosts.yaml baked into ironlog-vector; IRONLOG_VECTOR_ROLE=hosts. Quadlet ironlog-vector-hosts, Compose vector-hosts, Helm vector.hosts.

devices.label:
Vector role aws - OPTIONAL [AU-3]
Role: poll SQS, read S3, VRL normalise, disk buffer
Off by default: Compose profile aws, Quadlet ships disabled

data.notes: Teal: optional ingestion. vector/vector.yaml baked into ironlog-vector; IRONLOG_VECTOR_ROLE=aws. Helm vector.aws.enabled.

devices.label:
siem database - 30-day TTL [AU-11]
Role: 7 tables: cloudtrail, guardduty, vpc_flow,
s3_access, windows_events, linux_syslog, k8s_logs

data.notes: Blue: data. clickhouse/ddl/010_aws.sql and 020_hosts.sql. Text index idx_msg_text on windows_events, linux_syslog, k8s_logs; siem.log_search view is clickhouse/ddl/050_search.sql. Retention is 30 days with the S3 tier off, 400 with it on (images/README.md).

devices.label:
audit.query_archive - 2-year TTL [AU-9]
Role: audit trail of finished queries, filled by
query_archive_mv from system.query_log

svc_vector - write-only [AU-9]
Role: role siem_ingest, INSERT on siem.* only,
no reads; used by both Vector roles

Read-only accounts [AC-6]
svc_grafana_analyst: SELECT siem.* and log_search
svc_grafana_auditor: SELECT siem.* and audit.*

data.notes: Blue: access control. Roles siem_analyst and siem_auditor; profile siem_reader. Created by ironlog-schema.

devices.label:
S3 cold tier - OPTIONAL [AU-4]
Role: IRONLOG_S3_TIER=on (default off) moves parts
older than IRONLOG_HOT_DAYS to AWS S3 or S3-compatible

data.notes: Blue: optional data tier. Enabled by environment on the ironlog-clickhouse image, which generates config.d/20-storage-s3.xml at start. Live-tested 2026-11-04 on Oracle Linux 9 against a SeaweedFS S3-compatible store (quadlets/README.md); real AWS S3 not tested. Switching back off is unsupported.

devices.label:
Grafana 13.3.0 - :3000 [AU-5, AU-6]
Role: the only UI - dashboards, Log Search, SQL explore,
7 AU-5 ingestion-silence alerts; local accounts

data.notes: Amber: application. ironlog-grafana image, Open Source edition, ClickHouse plugin 4.23.4. Two baked ClickHouse datasources (analyst, auditor) over native 9000.

Amber: one-shot job from the ironlog-clickhouse image (command ironlog-schema): Quadlet ironlog-schema.service, Compose service schema, Helm post-install/upgrade hook Job. Runs against IRONLOG_CLICKHOUSE_HOST.

devices.label:
Analysts and auditors
Role: sign in to Grafana :3000 with its
local account; no SSO or MFA

ironlog-vector:0.61.0
Role: role hosts (HEC 8088, native 6000)
or role aws (SQS/S3); health :8686

ironlog-clickhouse:26.8.34.13
Role: ClickHouse 8123 + 9000, baked DDL and config,
ironlog-schema command, S3 tier switch

ironlog-grafana:13.3.0
Role: Grafana OSS 13.3.0 + ClickHouse plugin 4.23.4,
baked provisioning, dashboards, alert rules

podman Quadlets - Oracle Linux 9 [VERIFIED]
Role: single host, or split hosts (ClickHouse on one,
Grafana + Vector on another); systemd units

data.notes: Slate: deployment. quadlets/. Live-tested 2026-11-04 on OL 9.8, podman 5.8.2, SELinux enforcing, single-host and two-host split with S3 tier (quadlets/README.md, docs/log.md). Minimum podman 4.7.
Slate: deployment. docker-compose.yml; profiles aws and k3s are optional.

devices.label:
Helm chart - Kubernetes / OpenShift / EKS
Role: StatefulSet + schema hook Job; CI on kind
under restricted Pod Security (not OpenShift SCC)

data.notes: Slate: deployment. deploy/helm/ironlog, .github/workflows/helm.yml. Runs with arbitrary UID, GID 0.

devices.label:
Amazon ECS on EC2 - PLANNED, wave 2
Role: not built yet; no deploy/ecs/ in the repo.
Target named in images/README.md

data.notes: Grey: legacy, still in the repository; predates the portable container images.
